tools.name: plan_project_timeline
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a Gantt chart, project timeline, project schedule or project plan with milestones from a task list, wants to find the critical path and project duration, or asks for early start, early finish, late start, late finish, total float or free float (critical path method). Tak

tools.name: compare_timeline_scenarios
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what happens to a project schedule if a task slips, takes longer or shorter, or starts later: for example "if Design slips 5 days, when do we finish?" or "does the critical path change?". Takes the same task list and calendar as plan_project_timeline plus 1 to 4 scenarios
